priceBasis.label: Price basis
priceBasis.grossDescription: Gross prices stay the same when tax rates change. With net display, net prices are derived from the tax rate of the customer's country. Tax-free orders are always charged the net price.
priceBasis.netDescription: Net prices stay the same when tax rates change. Gross prices are derived from the tax rate of the customer's country and do not land on rounded amounts (net 10.00 € shows as 11.90 € at 19 % and 12.00 € at 20 %).
